The family dinner is not far from my home. We talk about music a lot. David's favorite subject is music. In fact, his wife runs a small bakery.
The old photo album is big and clean. My friend Lily is very kind. We often go to the library together. What's more, we eat rice almost every day.
After school, we play together. David drinks tea every morning. I am happy every day.
